The +21.9% 1M move reflects strong bullish options flow and institutional accumulation ahead of continued FY27 budget tailwinds. At 1.8x P/S with a $146B cap, it offers defensive beta during elevated VIX periods while retaining upside from PAC-3 missile demand surges.

UiPath is the leading enterprise RPA platform pivoting aggressively into agentic AI automation, a category with rapid 2026 enterprise adoption. The +16.2% 1M move with bullish options and institutional flow suggests smart money is positioning ahead of its agentic product monetization inflection. At 4.3x P/S, valuation is reasonable relative to AI SaaS peers, offering an asymmetric entry into the AI workflow automation theme.

Leidos is a defense IT and digital modernization specialist serving DoD, intelligence community, and civil agencies — distinct from traditional hardware primes like LMT. Only 1.0x P/S provides deep value against +14.2% momentum, with bullish options and institutional sponsorship signaling continued flow into government IT contracts tied to AI-enabled battle management. Current entry captures ongoing contract wins without stretched valuation.

MongoDB's Atlas vector search positions it as critical infrastructure for enterprise generative AI applications requiring unstructured data retrieval. The +15.7% 1M run with bullish options/institutional confirmation signals re-rating as Atlas AI workloads accelerate ARR growth. At 11.2x P/S and $31B cap, it offers mid-cap scalability without the crowding of mega-cap AI names already on the watchlist.

HII is the sole US builder of nuclear-powered aircraft carriers and a key Virginia-class submarine producer, directly benefiting from the Navy's 355-ship buildout and AUKUS submarine commitments. At just 0.8x P/S with $11B cap, it is the cheapest pure-play on naval shipbuilding — a structurally undersupplied capacity. The +8.8% 1M move with institutional bullishness suggests early-stage re-rating as multi-year shipbuilding contracts flow through earnings.
